import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        print("")
        return
    r = s[::-1]
    # Combined string: r + '#' + s, find longest prefix of r matching suffix of s
    t = r + '#' + s
    m = len(t)
    pi = [0] * m
    for i in range(1, m):
        j = pi[i - 1]
        while j > 0 and t[i] != t[j]:
            j = pi[j - 1]
        if t[i] == t[j]:
            j += 1
        pi[i] = j
    matched = pi[m - 1]
    # matched = length of longest palindromic suffix of s
    ans = s + s[:n - matched][::-1]
    sys.stdout.write(ans + "\n")

    main()
